title: SYN-DIGITS: A Synthetic Control Framework for Calibrated Digital Twin Simulation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework for calibrating LLM-based persona simulations to match human response distributions. While it mentions ethical considerations regarding the misuse of digital twins in its broader impact section and uses a dataset (OpinionQA) containing social issues, its primary focus is on statistical calibration and predictive accuracy rather than benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
